articles.image_caption: Navi Pillay (right), former judge of the International Criminal Court, was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize on October 9, 2026. The Trump administration announced sweeping sanctions on the court hours after the prize was announced.
articles.nri_angle: Pillay, born into an Indian Tamil family in Durban, is the most prominent figure of the Indian diaspora in international law, and the US-Europe rupture over the court she served puts the diaspora's strongest voice for global justice at the center of a geopolitical fight.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay Wins 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
articles.excerpt: The 85-year-old South African jurist of Indian Tamil descent was honoured by the Norwegian Nobel Committee for her efforts to promote peace and international law, from anti-apartheid activism to landmark war-crimes rulings.
articles.image_caption: Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay smiles during a public address. The Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the 85-year-old South African jurist the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her efforts to promote peace and international law.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin South African jurist Navi Pillay's Nobel Peace Prize is a landmark diaspora recognition — a descendant of Tamil indentured labourers honoured for shaping global justice.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
